## Interactive explainers and analysis code

### Neurovascular coupling and resting-state connectivity {#neurovascular-modeling}

A simulation framework showing how changes in cerebral blood flow, oxygen metabolism, and blood volume can, on their own, reshape and even reverse resting-state BOLD functional connectivity. The interactive companion page walks through the model step by step and includes a simulator you can run in the browser.

[Interactive explainer and simulator](https://virtualmarioe.github.io/neurovascular_modeling/) · [Repository](https://github.com/virtualmarioe/neurovascular_modeling) · Paper: [Archila-Meléndez, Sorg & Preibisch, *NeuroImage* 2020](publications.qmd)

### Predicting the probability of finding missing older adults {#missing-adults}

A supervised machine-learning study of 7,855 open-data cases of missing older adults in Colombia (1930 to 2021), identifying the individual and environmental factors that predict whether a missing person is later found. The interactive companion page presents the data, models, and findings.

[Interactive explainer](https://virtualmarioe.github.io/missing_adults/) · [Repository](https://github.com/virtualmarioe/missing_adults) · Paper: [Ruiz-Rizzo, Archila-Meléndez & González Veloza, *Journal of Computational Social Science* 2022](publications.qmd)
